### 2026-09-30 — This is my first Entry on Hack club so I don't really know how it works but I will try my best. On this session, I started by thinking of a good idea for a small project to start the half life program

**4h**

This is my first Entry on Hack club so I don't really know how it works but I will try my best. On this session, I started by thinking of a good idea for a small project to start the half life program. I First thought I would build something like an device that turns off your lights when it hears the voice command, but thought that was a bit too ambuish for this first project. I deciced that I would create a project that shows your current playing spotify song's album cover on the LCD screen. It would be a little desk prop you could look at while studying or to just create an nice asthetic. I already have an ESP, and wires to connect the LCD screen to the ESP,

### 2026-10-04 — This was the last planning day of my project. I started off by creating a plan of how the ESP32 would connect to the display. Its pretty simple since there is only 2 diffrent componets in this project

**5h**

This was the last planning day of my project. I started off by creating a plan of how the ESP32 would connect to the display. Its pretty simple since there is only 2 diffrent componets in this project.

![circuit_image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ciSSGkK0hMPayJKAraaFv1chbOLQfc3f/88476aac9972c32407209e7d23ba606dc75597210899c295ad517447b0b1f386.png)

after that I started the last stage, getting a base for my code. There is a few things that I cant setup yet So I put a filler in like the spoitfy API, and oviously didn't put my wifi or anything. After I get the actual parts that I need I will ovisouly test the code and find out a lot of things don't work but then I can fix it from there. Also I did some research about the Spotify api and apparently you need a server running for it to grab the new token, or you will have to re enter a token every 1 hour. So I will end up setting up a server that runs off my computer to grab the token to make everything easier.
